mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ad WHERE status = 1
SELECT dim_type AS dimType, dim_value AS dimValue FROM ad_target WHERE dim_type IN #{t} GROUP BY dim_type, dim_value
SELECT t.dim_value AS dimValue, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ad_target t JOIN ad a ON a.id = t.ad_id AND a.status = 1 WHERE t.dim_type IN #{t} GROUP BY t.dim_value
SELECT id, advertiser_id, title, creative_url, category_code, bid, daily_budget, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ad WHERE status = 1
SELECT id, advertiser_id, title, creative_url, category_code, bid, daily_budget, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ad WHERE status = 1 AND bid <= 3.00 AND daily_budget >= 10000 LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, advertiser_id, title, creative_url, category_code, bid, daily_budget, status, created_at, updated_at FROM ad WHERE id = #{id}
